asset.Name: Soldier Total Stats
asset.Description:
Adds a sortable TOT column with each soldier's total stats (HP + TU + ACC + STR + RFL + BRV) to the Manage, Recruit and dropship soldier screens, coloured red to green.

Save-safe. Not compatible with Soldier Total Column.
asset.Author: Reuven
asset.Credits: Inspired by Soldier Total Column by mnshdw.
